'''Rodas Borgin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the head of [[House Borgin/Legends|House Borgin]] and [[Duke of Serenno]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Rodas Borgin hailed from [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], in the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As a member of the [[House Borgin/Legends|House Borgin]], one of the [[Great Houses/Legends|major bloodlines]] that ruled the planet, he was born a wealthy [[Noble/Legends|patrician]]. His [[Rodas Borgin's father|father]] was head of the house, bearing the title of [[Count/Legends|Count]].

===Cleansing of Serenno===
When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the nobles of Serenno sided against the Republic. They had been coerced into doing so because of their ties with the Confederacy's leader, [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who was their liege lord the [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count of Serenno]]. At the end of the three-year conflict, the Republic emerged victorious and was reorganized into an authoritarian [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Shortly thereafter, a black-armored envoy of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] known as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] visited the assembled nobles of Serenno in the [[Great Assembly House/Legends|Great Assembly House]], and Rodas Borgin attended the gathering with his father. However, Rodas Borgin and the other patricians soon discovered that the meeting was a trap.

Vader accused the nobles of [[Treason/Legends|treason]], stating that an [[Cleansing of Serenno|exemplary punishment]] was to be applied to atone for Serenno's faults. The Emperor's envoy ordered that the son of each head of house should [[Death/Legends|kill]] the current title holder and take his place. With Vader threatening to kill everyone in the room if they refused, Rodas Borgin was the first to accept that macabre bargain. With a heavy heart and tears in the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], he drew his ceremonial [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]] and stabbed his father in the back. Although he admittedly loved his father, Rodas Borgin chose to preserve himself. Seeing what Rodas had done, the rest of the heirs started killing their own fathers. Soon the slaughter finished and the new head of the houses were officially named. Rodas Borgin [[Marriage/Legends|married]] the noblewoman [[Cretia Borgin|Cretia]] of [[House Malvern/Legends|House Malvern]], and the two sired a son named [[Pero Borgin|Pero]].<ref name="AotE-HT2" /> 

===Dooku's kidnapping===
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], Borgin met the Imperial agent [[Jahan Cross]] and was one of the people to know that Cross had murdered the Count of Serenno [[Adan Dooku]].<ref name="AotE-HT2" /> Borgin hired [[Aveca Dunn]] to kidnap Adan's ten-year-old son [[Bron Dooku]], with the intention of returning the boy to make it look like he had saved him. With that newfound glory, Borgin hoped he would be a hero and named regent of Serenno, but he did not tell Cross about his scheme.<ref name="AotE-HT3">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 3|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 3]]</ref> Protecting the young Dooku, Cross foiled Borgin's plans and tricked the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] into shooting Count Borgin.<ref name="AotE-HT5" />
